about.heading: About Al Tayer Motors
about.p1: Al Tayer Motors has been a trusted name in the UAE automotive market since 2018, with three premium showrooms across Abu Dhabi serving over 12,400 happy customers. We specialize in luxury and high-performance vehicles from Toyota, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Range Rover, Porsche, and Lexus.
about.p2: Every vehicle in our inventory is thoroughly inspected and comes with a complimentary 30-day warranty, full service history, and our signature "no surprises" pricing — what you see is what you pay, with all RTA fees and registration included.
about.p3: Our team speaks English, Arabic, Urdu, and Hindi, and we offer multilingual after-sales support for the lifetime of your vehicle.

0.title: Trade-in accepted
0.desc: Bring your current car and we'll appraise it on the spot — apply it instantly toward your new purchase.

1.title: Financing partners
1.desc: Pre-approved finance from Emirates NBD, ADCB, Mashreq, and 4 other UAE banks. 0% finance available on select models.

2.title: 30-day warranty
2.desc: Complimentary 30-day warranty on every used car, with optional extended coverage up to 2 years.

3.title: Free home delivery
3.desc: Free delivery within Abu Dhabi and Dubai. AED 250 to other Emirates. Vehicle arrives detailed and full of fuel.

4.title: Full service history
4.desc: Every vehicle comes with documented service records and a verified RTA Mulkiya history report.

5.title: Free inspection at home
5.desc: Not sure? Book a free 200-point inspection at your location before signing anything.

about.title: About

0.name: Sara K.
0.body: Absolutely outstanding service from start to finish. I came in looking at a 2023 Land Cruiser and the team — special shoutout to Khalid — was patient, transparent, and never pushy. They even arranged for me to take it home overnight before I committed. Paperwork was painless and the car was delivered to my office spotless. I'd buy from them again.
0.reply: Thank you Sara! It was a pleasure helping you find the right Land Cruiser. Enjoy every mile — and don't forget your first free service is on us!

1.name: Ahmed H.
1.body: Bought a BMW X5 here after looking at four other dealerships. Al Tayer's price was AED 12,000 lower than the next-best offer for an identical car, and the inspection report they provided was incredibly thorough — even minor stuff like wheel alignment was noted. Test drove three cars in one afternoon, no pressure. Will recommend to family.

2.name: Fatima R.
2.body: Good overall experience. Pricing is fair and the team is professional. Took off one star because the financing approval took 4 days when they had said 24 hours — but once that came through, the rest was smooth. The car was delivered home as promised.
2.reply: Hi Fatima — apologies for the financing delay! That was an issue at the bank's end, but we've since restructured our process to escalate any approval taking over 48 hours. Glad you enjoyed the car!

3.name: Mohamed J.
3.body: Bought my second car from them this month. The trade-in offer on my old vehicle was AED 8,000 more than any other dealer quoted. The G63 I picked up was in absolutely showroom condition. Khalid is honest, accommodating, and remembered me from my last purchase 2 years ago. This is how a dealership should be run.
